body.name: \(Q_{n,h}\)
body.space: probability laws on a Gaussian signal and an estimated game
body.def: The law obtained by first drawing \(\widehat{\mathsf G}_n\) from its \(P_{n,h}\)-marginal and then, conditionally on that game, drawing the signal from \(N(h,\widehat\Sigma_n)\); in particular, \(\mathcal L_{Q_{n,h}}(\widehat{\mathsf G}_n)=\mathcal L_{P_{n,h}}(\widehat{\mathsf G}_n)\).
